# Protocol onboarding inventory

<!-- Generated by `python3 inventory/lib/inventory.py render` from `inventory/evidence/`. Do not edit. -->

Which onboarded Cardano protocol has a complete Tx3 bundle. A complete row has a published interface pulled by version and digest, a decoded unsigned resolution on its network's public TRP, six typed clients, docs with a working example, and versioned MCP tools with a matching Skill, all for the same release. A row stays outstanding, with each missing item named, until every item is present.

Milestone period: 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30. Test dates are the actual UTC dates of each run.

New protocols complete: 0 of 4. Each new identity counts once across networks and releases; the baseline below is listed separately and is not counted.

| Protocol | Team | Operation | Network | Release | Status | Test date |

| [Minswap V2](#minswap-v2) | Minswap | `place_exact_in_order` | preprod | `open-tx3/minswap-v2` unreleased | outstanding (7) | - |
| [Liqwid V2](#liqwid-v2) | Liqwid | `supply_ada` | preview | `open-tx3/liqwid-v2` unreleased | outstanding (7) | - |
| [WingRiders V2](#wingriders-v2) | WingRiders | `place_swap_request` | mainnet | `open-tx3/wingriders-v2` unreleased | outstanding (7) | - |
| [Dano Finance](#dano-clmm) | Dano Finance (Danogo) | `swap_single_pool` | preprod | `open-tx3/dano-clmm` unreleased | outstanding (7) | - |

## Minswap V2

Team: Minswap. Operation `place_exact_in_order` on preprod, coordinate `open-tx3/minswap-v2`.

Outstanding:

- release: no publication-pass record yet (version, digests, source tag, CI run, sign-off)
- reconciliation: identity not yet checked against existing source, the historical catalog and every live registry namespace
- resolution: waits on the release
- clients: waits on the release
- docs: waits on the release
- tools: waits on the release
- registry: waits on the release

Selection evidence:

- activity: 162,169 transactions (whole dapp) in the 30 days to 2026-11-15 (2026-11-15; [source](https://cardano.org/apps/leaderboard/))
- tvl: about $11.7M (DefiLlama snapshots of 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-24; [source](https://defillama.com/chain/cardano))
- active wallets: about 6,400 (Minswap V2, rolling count) (read by 2026-11-24; the source shows no snapshot date; [source](https://poolflow.net/markets))
